0022600009.text: The San Antonio Spurs host the Houston Rockets in a regular-season game that is the Spurs' second of the 2026-27 season, though neither team has a 2026-27 result yet. The Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain), and the Rockets have no listed absences. The Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 145-120 win in San Antonio on March 8, 2026.
